name: iac-planning
description: Infrastructure as Code planning. Tool selection (Terraform / OpenTofu / Pulumi / CloudFormation / CDK / Bicep), module design + reusability, state management (remote backend + locking), environment separation via workspaces / directories / accounts, CI/CD integration, drift detection, policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Checkov), secrets handling. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
